episodes.title: From the Ashes of Tragedy
episodes.summary: The murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman lead the LAPD to the home of O.J. Simpson.

episodes.title: The Run of His Life
episodes.summary: With O.J. Simpson missing in the white Bronco, Robert Shapiro and Robert Kardashian deal with the fallout, as the D.A.'s office and LAPD scramble to save face and find him.

episodes.title: The Dream Team
episodes.summary: Marcia Clark announces that O.J. Simpson has been charged. Robert Shapiro seeks advice from F. Lee Bailey and comes up with a provocative strategy. As Shapiro starts putting together "The Dream Team", he must convince O.J. to hire Johnnie Cochran.

episodes.title: 100% Not Guilty
episodes.summary: Johnnie Cochran brings an energy that transforms the case. As jury selection gets underway, the prosecution and defense seek out the assistance of jury research experts, who come back with some surprising results. Meanwhile, Faye Resnick publishes a tell-all book, complicating the court proceedings.

episodes.title: The Race Card
episodes.summary: As the trial begins, Christopher Darden and Johnnie Cochran face off in court. Chris has doubts about Mark Fuhrman as a witness. The jury visits the crime scene. directed by John Singleton.

episodes.title: Marcia, Marcia, Marcia
episodes.summary: As Marcia Clark juggles her home and work obligations, she starts to feel the public scrutiny of her appearance.

episodes.title: Conspiracy Theories
episodes.summary: Conspiracy theories start to arise around the case. The prosecution debates whether they should have O.J. Simpson try on the gloves in court.

episodes.title: A Jury in Jail
episodes.summary: Months into the trial, cut off from their families, society and the media, the jurors grow stir crazy and start becoming unlikely targets for the prosecution and the defense. Meanwhile, the country gets an introduction to the science of DNA evidence.

episodes.title: Manna from Heaven
episodes.summary: Johnnie Cochran and F. Lee Bailey head across the country to get their hands on the Mark Fuhrman tapes. Judge Ito must decide whether the tapes, and the racial epithets they contain, are admissible.

episodes.title: The Verdict
episodes.summary: In the season finale, the prosecution and defense make their closing statements; the jurors deliberate; and the verdict is given.

episodes.title: The Man Who Would Be Vogue
episodes.summary: The murder of Gianni Versace turns the eyes of the world onto Miami Beach.

episodes.title: Manhunt
episodes.summary: Andrew Cunanan arrives in Miami to stalk Gianni Versace.

episodes.title: A Random Killing
episodes.summary: Chicago real estate tycoon Lee Miglin is murdered in what police describe as a random killing.

episodes.title: House By the Lake
episodes.summary: Minneapolis architect David Madson is forced to go on the run with Andrew Cunanan.

episodes.title: Don't Ask Don't Tell
episodes.summary: Naval officer Jeffrey Trail meets Andrew Cunanan for the first time, and Gianni Versace reveals his sexuality to the world.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.summary: Andrew Cunanan celebrates his birthday in San Diego as his life starts to fall apart.

episodes.title: Ascent
episodes.summary: Andrew Cunanan leaves behind a troubled family life as Donatella Versace struggles to find her role within the Versace empire.

episodes.title: Creator / Destroyer
episodes.summary: A young Andrew Cunanan struggles with his oppressive father as a young Gianni Versace becomes a designer.

episodes.title: Alone
episodes.summary: The hunt for spree-killer Andrew Cunanan comes to a frantic end.

episodes.title: Exiles
episodes.summary: After the death of her boss, White House staffer Linda Tripp is moved to The Pentagon where she meets Monica Lewinsky. Paula Jones decides to sue The President for sexual harassment.

episodes.title: The President Kissed Me
episodes.summary: Monica reveals to Linda that she is having an affair with the most powerful man in the world.

episodes.title: Not to Be Believed
episodes.summary: Tensions rise between Monica and the President. Paula is offered a settlement. Linda begins to feel that she has a target on her back.

episodes.title: The Telephone Hour
episodes.summary: Monica leans on Linda for support. Linda begins documenting their conversations.

episodes.title: Do You Hear What I Hear?
episodes.summary: As Monica prepares to leave D.C., she grows concerned that someone is sharing news about her affair. Linda meets with the FBI.

episodes.title: Man Handled
episodes.summary: The Office of the Independent Counsel ensnares Monica Lewinsky, holding her for 12 traumatizing hours in a hotel room.

episodes.title: The Assassination of Monica Lewinsky
episodes.summary: The world learns about the affair and Monica Lewinsky becomes the most famous woman in America.

episodes.title: Stand by Your Man
episodes.summary: The President must admit the truth to the Nation - and to The First Lady.

episodes.title: The Grand Jury
episodes.summary: Monica Lewinsky and Linda Tripp tell their stories to 23 strangers.

episodes.title: The Wilderness
episodes.summary: The Starr Report brings the world to a standstill. The President is impeached. Linda faces the aftermath of her decisions, Paula makes desperate choices, and Monica considers how to move on with her life.
